column1: # Per-step cost on a healthy run: step, wall s, cpu s (user+sys of the step's
# process tree), slots it ran with. run.mjs starts the longest first and warns
# when a step's cpu is 2x this and a minute more (wall when cpu is 0). Rewrite
# with NTS_GATE_RECORD_TIMES=1 on a run you have checked is healthy.
# Measured 2026-10-07 at a34559ddd (after the Program::cycles fix), 12 slots,
# load 20-40 from other sessions. Steps that FAILed there (llvm-rc, rc,
# bench-agree, divergence: red on main) still ran their whole population.
